taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Preflight caching and credentialed CORS across an actual policy transition
controls.source_trace: Determine which decision is cached by the browser and which remains enforced on the actual response/server operation. Track method/header/origin and profile identity.
controls.implementation_branch: Classify browser-readable protected data separately from a cookie-authenticated mutation. The browser preflight cache differs from an HTTP response cache; simple requests need no preflight. Actual credentials and SameSite admission still matter. Cached preflight permission does not remove response CORS checks; if only a PUT commits, investigate server authorization/CSRF and compare fresh, cached and expired states.
controls.controlled_verification: In an owned fixture compare fresh and previously preflighted contexts before and after narrowing permission; observe actual browser reads and committed synthetic effects.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A cached successful OPTIONS response does not alone expose a credentialed body or authorize a state change.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Enforce the actual request/response boundary and retest both cached and fresh browser paths.
